notes.title: Update - Ekorella Vol. 1 - Build 17824079
EKORELLA VOL. 1 NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
🎉 [b]Ekorella is now available![/b] 🌟  

The wait is over! We are thrilled to announce that [b]Ekorella[/b] is officially available on Steam. 🌿✨  

Dive into a vibrant world full of mysteries, adventures, and unforgettable characters. Join Green and his friends on a unique journey through enchanting landscapes and unexpected dangers. Get ready to solve puzzles, face strategic battles, and uncover the secrets this fascinating universe holds.  

[b]Ekorella [/b]is an adventure crafted with love, and we can’t wait to see your stories and experiences in the game. ❤️  

[b]Don’t wait any longer! Play now and explore everything Ekorella has to offer:[/b]  

📣 And don’t forget to share your adventures with us and leave a review. Your feedback means the world to us!  

🌟 Welcome to the world of [b]Ekorella[/b]!
